name: Stadium of Delphi
scope: The surviving Stadium of Delphi as photographed in March 2012, including the open track, north limestone tiers, curved west end, southern terrace remnants and east starting-line and entrance remains.

originalReview.notes: The March 2012 west-to-east view shows the long north limestone seats and rear rockfall wall on the slope, worn stair partitions, pale grassy track, eroded southern terrace and low broken stone at the east entrance.

review.method: Exact Qualla original and named native public-domain release
review.notes: The exact Qualla original matches the native Commons file and the named photographer and original uploader are the same. The file history records the transfer from English Wikipedia with Challisrussia’s explicit CC0 release.
